'''Star Tours Flight 407''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] just before the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]]. It arrived on time at Gate 2F at 0615 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 0710.
